children: Several major energy companies said they plan to ditch their New York listings in favor of the Texas Stock Exchange in a major win for the nascent exchange.

Pipeline company Energy Transfer said Thursday it will transfer the listing of its common units from the New York Stock Exchange to the TXSE, confirming an earlier report from The Wall Street Journal. Sunoco and SunocoCorp, as well as natural gas compression services provider USA Compression Partners, also disclosed plans to switch their listings from the NYSE to the TXSE.
The companies expect their units to start trading on the TXSE, under their current ticker symbols, on Oct. 5.
In separate statements, the companies said the moves align their Texas-based legacies with TXSE's technology-driven platform to support their growth.
